name: TC-VA-002 — 归档页与审核页信息差异 [P1]
description: 验证归档页只展示最终基准包快照，不展示审核操作和评审过程流转
page: 迭代详情-归档基准包 tab

steps.expression: (() => { const archiveTab = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')).find(t => t.textContent.includes('归档')); if (archiveTab) archiveTab.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const noReviewAction = !text.includes('提交审核') && !text.includes('确认通过') && !text.includes('打回买手'); const noUploadAction = !text.includes('补充上传') && !text.includes('发起评审'); const hasPackage = text.includes('基准包') || text.includes('归档'); return { noReviewAction, noUploadAction, hasPackage }; })()
steps.description: 验证归档页无审核/上传操作

steps.expression: (() => { const sampleTab = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')).find(t => t.textContent.includes('试拍')); if (sampleTab) { sampleTab.click(); return { canSwitchToSample: true }; } return { canSwitchToSample: false }; })()
steps.description: 验证可回看试拍与评审tab

_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 切换到归档基准包tab
2. 验证不展示审核/上传操作
3. 切换到试拍与评审tab回看
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 归档页不展示提交审核/确认通过/打回/补充上传等操作
2. 可切换到试拍与评审tab回看评审记录
3. 归档页只展示最终基准包快照
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/视觉归档
